info.name: Banking API — Full Test Suite
info.description:
End-to-end tests for every endpoint: happy paths, validation errors, business-rule conflicts, idempotency, atomicity, pagination.

Self-contained: it creates its own customer and accounts on each run, so it can be re-run without resetting the DB. Only uses the seeded CLOSED account acct_004 and acct_001.

Run in order (Collection Runner) against `npm start` with default .env (AUTH_MODE=none, withdrawal window 00:00-24:00, daily limit 5000).
